title: ILA 101 – Pricing and Introduction to Valuation and Risk Management

topics.title: Individual Life and Annuity Product Design and Pricing
topics.objective: The candidate will understand the designs of the common Life and Annuity products and their associated features and inherent risks, and the methods to design and price these products.

outcomes.text: Describe and compare various life insurance and annuity product designs
Evaluate and apply pricing practices for life and annuity products
Describe and apply the common profit metrics (IRR, Value of New Business, Embedded Value, ROE) used in pricing insurance products
Explain and apply nonforfeiture calculation techniques

topics.title: Assumption Development and Experience Studies
topics.objective: The candidate will understand different types of actuarial assumptions and how experience studies are designed and used for evaluating past experience and for setting assumptions.

outcomes.text: Describe types of actuarial assumptions commonly used for life insurance and annuity actuarial functions
Describe and evaluate mortality, lapse, premium persistency, term conversions and utilization assumptions used for various purposes, and apply methods and techniques for their development
Explain and apply actuarial credibility methods
Describe and apply the framework, process, and significant considerations for creating modern mortality tables used by life insurance companies
Describe the process and apply techniques for experience studies

topics.title: Product Management
topics.objective: The candidate will understand common issues and practices related to Product Management.

outcomes.text: Describe and assess insurance and annuity distribution approaches and underwriting approaches
Describe and apply the significant US and Canadian tax regulations relating to the taxation of individual life and annuity insurance products
Recommend and justify changes to non-guaranteed elements
Describe and evaluate the challenges insurers face in a rising interest rate environment

topics.title: Introduction to Life and Annuity Valuation Concepts
topics.objective: The candidate will understand common valuation and capital techniques used in US, Canadian, and international regulatory frameworks.

outcomes.text: Describe the US statutory actuarial framework, including the principles-based reserves and calculate basic life insurance reserves
Describe the US GAAP actuarial framework and calculate term insurance reserves and deferred acquisition cost
Describe the IFRS actuarial framework, including the basic calculation of reserves
Explain and apply methods in capital management across various jurisdictions

topics.title: Introduction to Assets and Risk Management
topics.objective: The candidate will understand various techniques for addressing the mitigation of risk within a life insurance and annuity context.

outcomes.text: Describe and evaluate approaches for integrating ALM into an enterprise's risk and financial management framework
Describe and apply the basic concepts of cash flow matching, immunization, duration/convexity matching, segmentation
Describe how common insurance guarantees generate embedded options and calculate the value of these options
Explain the function and attributes of common assets used to support life insurance and annuity liabilities
Describe basic terms, concepts, and types of life insurance reinsurance arrangements
Explain various methods and perform financial statement calculations of reinsurance transactions, including yearly renewable term, coinsurance, modified coinsurance, and funds withheld arrangements
